requirements.title: Local review-regression workflow
requirements.requirement: Provide a local CLI and Python API for generate, validate, export, import, compare and report; separate package-consistency from CNC advisory results.
requirements.rationale: The useful product is a repeatable reviewer test, not another manufacturing-approval app.
requirements.acceptance: A clean consumer runs the supplied complete workflow offline with imported results and sees both tracks independently.
acceptance_commands: Independent Windows installed rfqfuzz demo (60/20s); Linux consumer_workflow.py (300/120s); own check_family_semantics.py and check_consumer_report.py; check_diagnosis_meaning.py; source_archive_provenance.py and archive equivalence; tools/audit_consumer_handoff.py (1694files, both15case demos and3fresh families pass)

requirements.title: Sufficient public context and private answers
requirements.requirement: Version PacketSpec, CapabilityProfile, MutationSpec, OracleRecord, ReviewResult and RunManifest. Every premise needed by a reviewer is public; answer keys and defect labels are private.
requirements.rationale: Hidden intent makes an unfair benchmark; metadata leakage makes an easy but meaningless one.
requirements.acceptance: Schema tests reject missing authority/units where required; an export audit finds no oracle fields or revealing labels; missing critical-callout and revision cases expose their governing contract.
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/contracts tests/m0 -q (64 passed)

requirements.title: Bounded realistic part families
requirements.requirement: Support one-solid plate/hole-pattern, blind-bore/counterbore block and open-pocket block families with explicit feature groups and setups.
requirements.rationale: Simple analytic geometry supports independent measurement while still exercising hardware-review problems.
requirements.acceptance: Each family exports/reimports correctly over documented parameter bounds; unsupported topology fails explicitly; representative drawings receive visual inspection.
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/geometry tests/generation -q (24 passed)

requirements.title: Actual STEP, PDF and PNG artifacts
requirements.requirement: Produce ordinary STEP and visible vector PDF, with PNG rendered from that PDF. Record units, hash, view/feature associations and rendering provenance.
requirements.rationale: Reviewers must consume real engineering artifacts, not privileged generator objects.
requirements.acceptance: Independent STEP reader confirms relevant geometry; PDF text and raster checks agree on required visible labels; PNG remains readable; hidden/clipped text fails validation.

requirements.title: Six objective fault operators
requirements.requirement: Implement O01 diameter/model mismatch, O02 scoped count mismatch, O03 units mismatch, O04 incompatible global material declarations, O05 removal of a declared requirement and O06 release-association mismatch.
requirements.rationale: These are useful and checkable package errors without pretending to solve full drawing intent or CNC process planning.
requirements.acceptance: Each operator has prerequisites, allowed deltas and invariant checks; unsupported/ambiguous applications are rejected; the final visible/exported defect is verified.

requirements.title: Conditional manufacturing track
requirements.requirement: Implement A01 wall advisory, A02 hole depth/diameter advisory, A03 named setup envelope exclusion and A04 finish/tolerance-stage context; include material-dependent applicability.
requirements.rationale: Supplier recommendations and process defaults are conditional. Conflating them with impossibility would create bad engineering advice.
requirements.acceptance: Boundary and alternate-profile cases produce the specified conclusion class; unknown finish stage stays unknown unless a public default resolves it; stock/fixture allowances are explicit.

requirements.title: Repairs, valid lookalikes and uncertainty controls
requirements.requirement: Pair objective defects with repaired twins and legitimate alternatives; include underdetermined cases and sparse CAD-authoritative drawings.
requirements.rationale: A useful reviewer catches errors without flagging every omission or pretending incomplete evidence is enough.
requirements.acceptance: Always-flag, always-clear and always-abstain baselines each fail the relevant metrics; controls cover correct units, REF values, aliases, precedence and independent document revisions.

requirements.title: Independent oracle and fixture quarantine
requirements.requirement: Validate re-imported STEP measurements, actual visible drawing content and mutation isolation using code separated from generation; quarantine uncertainty and collateral defects.
requirements.rationale: Generator metadata alone proves only that the generator agrees with itself.
requirements.acceptance: Analytic checks and final-artifact measurements agree within recorded tolerance; deliberate export corruption is caught; invalid fixtures and their reasons are retained and excluded transparently.

requirements.title: Versioned rule provenance
requirements.requirement: Store source/date, short paraphrase, applicability, units, threshold, comparison, severity, precedence and limits for each rule. Label synthetic profiles and project-selected values.
requirements.rationale: Published guidance varies by supplier; reproducibility requires knowing which policy produced the expected answer.
requirements.acceptance: Every scored advisory points to a profile/rule version; unknown material/profile combinations abstain; no unsupported universal manufacturing threshold appears in reports.
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/contracts tests/profiles -q (96 passed)

requirements.title: Explicit conclusion semantics
requirements.requirement: Distinguish contradiction, profile_exclusion, advisory, missing_information, supported_clear and unsupported; separate fixture invalidity and execution errors.
requirements.rationale: A binary pass/fail label loses the important engineering distinction between contradiction, risk and absent evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Contract and scorer tests cover every class; replacing unknown with clear or advisory with impossible causes acceptance failures.

requirements.title: Vendor-neutral review interface
requirements.requirement: Support ordinary public bundle export, structured-result import and a bounded local-process adapter. Demonstrate one genuine external reviewer as well as the reference path.
requirements.rationale: A harness usable only by its own checker is not enough. Offline use should not depend on a paid API.
requirements.acceptance: The same bundle reaches two independent review paths. At M0 the external reviewer examines the O01 PDF/PNG drawing, STEP geometry and public manufacturing-stage context; its raw response/provenance is retained. STEP-only integrations are later advisory-track evidence and cannot substitute for this gate.

requirements.title: Coverage and failed-run accounting
requirements.requirement: Record explicit completion, partial, unsupported, timeout and error states plus reviewed modalities/obligations; preserve raw outputs.
requirements.rationale: Silence or a crash must not masquerade as a clean part or inflate accuracy.
requirements.acceptance: Missing/malformed results, partial runs, empty findings and explicit clear responses produce distinct reports and denominators; interrupted runs can resume without overwriting history.

requirements.title: Evidence-aware matching and adjudication
requirements.requirement: Match category/conclusion/location or feature evidence one-to-one; deduplicate root-cause findings; keep unmatched findings unadjudicated until reviewed.
requirements.rationale: Vague warnings are not detections, and an unexpected finding may reveal a real fixture defect.
requirements.acceptance: A wrong-region warning does not match; duplicates cannot increase recall; unit-root-cause grouping works; answer-key corrections create a new version and invalidate stale comparisons.
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/contracts tests/scoring tests/adapters -q (51 passed)

requirements.title: Honest per-track metrics
requirements.requirement: Report operator recall, named-clean-obligation false-alert rate, explicit false-clear rate, abstention, coverage, invalid/error rates and counts; no composite intelligence score.
requirements.rationale: The corpus proves only its finite obligations. A high detection rate alone can reward indiscriminate warnings.
requirements.acceptance: Known synthetic result sets yield hand-calculated numerators/denominators; unadjudicated findings prevent finalized precision claims; misses and explicit false clears stay distinct.
acceptance_commands: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/contracts tests/scoring tests/adapters -q (51 passed)

requirements.title: Actionable version regression
requirements.requirement: Compare runs on identical suite/oracle/profile versions and show changed findings with artifact evidence; reject incompatible comparisons by default.
requirements.rationale: The practical outcome is diagnosing a change in a review tool.
requirements.acceptance: A consumer identifies a detected-to-missed case and a new false alert from the report; mismatched oracle/profile hashes are flagged. Deliberately injected reviewer regressions are labeled and kept separate from genuine external observations.

requirements.title: Replay and leakage-resistant partitions
requirements.requirement: Record versions, hashes, seeds, environment and raw results; split by source family/layout/ancestry; keep all twins in one partition.
requirements.rationale: Random seeds do not guarantee reproducibility or prevent near-duplicate leakage.
requirements.acceptance: Same configuration reproduces semantics within documented tolerances; split audit finds no ancestry overlap; exported packets omit mutation-revealing names/metadata.

requirements.title: Challenge the validator and scorer
requirements.requirement: Use independent review, analytic examples and deliberate evaluator faults in unit conversion, comparison, severity, deduplication, leakage and unknown handling.
requirements.rationale: A passing self-generated corpus can conceal a broken evaluation system.
requirements.acceptance: At least one relevant broken implementation in each category is detected by the acceptance suite; surviving mutants have an explicit limitation or block release.

requirements.title: Inspectible offline report
requirements.requirement: Create escaped local HTML containing source crop/page, geometric evidence where relevant, expected/actual conclusion, rule provenance and regression context.
requirements.rationale: Engineers need to debug a concrete issue, not merely read a score.
requirements.acceptance: An independent reader can trace an example from report to exact source artifact and expected contract; reports work without a server/network; embedded arbitrary text cannot execute scripts.

requirements.title: Bounded and explicit data handling
requirements.requirement: Validate schemas, file signatures, paths, size/pages/solids and process timeouts; do not execute packet text or send data to hosted services by default.
requirements.rationale: Drawings are untrusted inputs and often private. Resource failures must be observable.
requirements.acceptance: Malformed/path-traversal/oversized cases fail with retained reasons; adapter timeout terminates its work; no network access is needed for the offline consumer workflow.

requirements.title: Consumer evidence and truthful release claims
requirements.requirement: Provide clean-install examples, an actual external-review walkthrough, known limits, source/dependency/license inventory and a factual unpublished blog draft.
requirements.rationale: Portfolio evidence requires a working consumer experience and verifiable engineering decisions.
requirements.acceptance: Independent consumer repeats the workflow; report and raw results are retained. Broad industry-usefulness claims require separately authored and engineer-reviewed evidence; otherwise label synthetic limitations.

requirements.title: Traceable agent implementation
requirements.requirement: Tie tasks to requirements, prerequisites, acceptance commands, retained evidence and local commits. Separate generator, validator and evaluator ownership where useful.
requirements.rationale: Modern agent work is credible when its outcomes can be checked and resumed.
requirements.acceptance: Every Must ID has completion evidence; task graph has no cycles; milestone decisions and unresolved assumptions are recorded; no publication/push occurs.

requirements.rationale: An open-source tool is less useful if only its author environment can run it.
requirements.acceptance: Fresh environments pass the core demo with semantic artifact checks; platform-specific limits are documented; no SolidWorks, GPU or paid model is a core requirement.

requirements.title: Engineer-authored external cases
requirements.requirement: Allow a user to register owned STEP/PDF packets with explicit feature mappings, finite obligations and manually reviewed expected answers.
requirements.rationale: This is the most direct route from a synthetic toolkit to a team's actual regression suite.
requirements.acceptance: At least one separately authored packet works without generator-private fields; unsupported mappings are rejected; provenance/license and review notes are retained.

requirements.title: Elementary tolerance and thread-depth operators
requirements.requirement: Add contradictory numeric intervals/dimension chains and simple blind-bore engagement conflicts only with explicit modeling assumptions.
requirements.rationale: These are useful next cases, but functional tolerance/GD&T interpretation and tap geometry can introduce ambiguity.
requirements.acceptance: Independent arithmetic/geometry checks and valid REF/alternate-process controls establish each case; uncertain process assumptions prevent scoring.

requirements.title: External interoperability fixtures
requirements.requirement: Use a small licensed NIST or separately authored STEP/PMI set for importer robustness, not as unquestioned good-drawing ground truth.
requirements.rationale: External files exercise failure modes missed by generated examples.
requirements.acceptance: Every case records provenance and intended check; NIST limitations are stated; unsupported PMI produces explicit unavailable data.

requirements.title: Interactive evidence navigation
requirements.requirement: Add a local 3D highlight and linked page/feature navigation to the static report.
requirements.rationale: This could reduce diagnostic effort once the report has demonstrated value.
requirements.acceptance: A consumer locates the affected face and annotation without interpreting internal IDs; static report remains usable without the viewer.

requirements.title: Broader presentation metamorphisms
requirements.requirement: Vary font/layout/view order and PNG resolution within known legibility bounds; preserve meaning.
requirements.rationale: Review quality should not depend entirely on one drawing template.
requirements.acceptance: Meaning-preserving variants retain expected conclusions; illegible or ambiguously associated cases are quarantined; transfer errors are separately reported.

requirements.title: Optional hosted reviewer integration
requirements.requirement: Add a live model API adapter only after offline/manual integration works, with explicit opt-in data transfer and budget.
requirements.rationale: This makes repeated model evaluation easier without burdening the basic tool.
requirements.acceptance: Record model/prompt/cost where available; replay needs no API key; missing credentials and exceeded budget fail clearly.

requirements.title: Additional independent oracle signal
requirements.requirement: Cross-check a representative subset with another CAD reader or separately authored geometry and human review.
requirements.rationale: A shared OCCT kernel leaves common-mode risk even with independent modules.
requirements.acceptance: Publish disagreement analysis; never select the preferred answer merely because it agrees with the generator.

requirements.title: Failure minimization
requirements.requirement: Shrink a failing packet/parameter set while preserving the independently validated failure.
requirements.rationale: Smaller reproductions could help reviewer maintainers debug.
requirements.acceptance: Every shrink is revalidated and retains the same expected obligation; minimization never changes the conclusion without recording it.

requirements.title: Semantic AP242 PMI
requirements.requirement: Consume supported semantic PMI where present; never assume STEP includes material/tolerance intent.
requirements.rationale: PMI could broaden valid alternate representations.
requirements.acceptance: Explicitly supported entities round-trip with evidence; absent or unsupported PMI is unknown, not a parser success claim.

requirements.title: Fixed-tool accessibility challenges
requirements.requirement: Add simple reach/radius cases under a fully declared tool catalog, setup and alternate-process boundary.
requirements.rationale: This adds geometric DFM depth but requires more careful process assumptions.
requirements.acceptance: Independent geometric witness supports a named-profile exclusion; other machines/tools are not ruled out globally.

requirements.title: Reviewer-output normalization assistance
requirements.requirement: Use an optional model to propose mappings from free prose to Finding records, subject to review or calibrated validation.
requirements.rationale: It can lower adapter effort, but an opaque judge must not control ground truth.
requirements.acceptance: Raw text and proposed mapping are retained; disputed mappings remain unadjudicated; deterministic structured path stays available.

requirements.title: A new general DFM approval application
requirements.requirement: Do not offer arbitrary upload-and-certify behavior or imply that a passing benchmark approves a part for manufacture.
requirements.rationale: The original idea already exists and general feasibility requires more manufacturing context.
requirements.acceptance: Docs/UI explicitly describe testing reviewers; no global machinable badge or certification claim.

requirements.title: Arbitrary 2D-to-3D reconstruction
requirements.requirement: Do not infer complete geometry from arbitrary PDF/PNG or measure manufacturing dimensions from drawing pixels.
requirements.rationale: Projection ambiguity and image scaling make strong geometric claims unsafe.
requirements.acceptance: Document-only review has explicit modality limits; model-dependent obligations require STEP and correspondence.

requirements.title: Native proprietary CAD drawing support
requirements.requirement: Do not parse .slddrw or require SolidWorks/Document Manager in the open-source core.
requirements.rationale: Licensing, platform and format complexity add little to the central testing contribution.
requirements.acceptance: Unsupported native files explain the PDF/STEP export route; no bundled proprietary keys or libraries.

requirements.title: Complete GD&T or functional approval
requirements.requirement: Do not certify ASME/ISO compliance, complete dimensioning, tolerance stack-ups or inferred design intent.
requirements.rationale: This needs broader semantics, standards access and domain judgment; sparse drawings can be correct.
requirements.acceptance: Only named finite obligations are scored; no proprietary standard tables copied into the project.

requirements.title: General CAM and manufacturing simulation
requirements.requirement: Exclude five-axis/turning process planning, fixture synthesis, cutting-force/tool-life simulation, cycle time and price.
requirements.rationale: These are separate substantial products and defeat a small feasible scope.
requirements.acceptance: No report suggests process simulation or physical manufacture was performed.

requirements.title: Other manufacturing processes
requirements.requirement: Exclude injection molding, die casting, stamping and sheet-metal bending.
requirements.rationale: Each needs distinct geometry/rules/oracles, and adjacent benchmark work already exists.
requirements.acceptance: CNC track boundaries remain explicit; architecture extensibility is not advertised as implemented support.

requirements.title: Arbitrary imported artifact mutation
requirements.requirement: Do not automatically edit unrestricted customer PDFs or arbitrary STEP topology.
requirements.rationale: Proving semantic correspondence and mutation isolation is much harder outside controlled families.
requirements.acceptance: External cases are manually registered and independently reviewed; unsupported mutations refuse clearly.

requirements.title: Universal material/finish predictions
requirements.requirement: Do not generate a general compatibility database, coating compensation or machining parameter recommendations.
requirements.rationale: Published supplier guidance is conditional and insufficient for universal rules.
requirements.acceptance: Use only explicit sourced/profile assumptions; missing applicability yields unknown.

requirements.title: Hosted service or full Gas Town deployment
requirements.requirement: Exclude accounts, billing, multi-tenant uploads, orchestration services and a large autonomous agent fleet.
requirements.rationale: They add operational work before the engineering tool is useful.
requirements.acceptance: The core runs locally; Beads stays optional development tooling.

requirements.title: Unapproved publication or invented experience
requirements.requirement: Do not push, deploy, send supplier orders, publish blog content or claim personal shop-floor experience/results not evidenced.
requirements.rationale: The user's standing constraint is local commits only, and a credible portfolio must remain factual.
requirements.acceptance: All artifacts and article drafts stay local; reported results cite actual retained evidence.
